newsitem.title: USA: CBOT corn called to open one to two cents lower.
newsitem.headline: CBOT corn called to open one to two cents lower.

text.p: CBOT corn futures were called to open one to two cents per bushel lower on a decline in soybeans overnight and expectations soy values will slide further Tuesday, as well as on improving corn condition ratings, traders said.
USDA Monday said the U.S. corn crop as of Sunday was 74 percent good to excellent, above the 67 percent in that category the previous week.
Forecasts for good crop weather to continue in the U.S. Midwest also will weigh on the market.
CBOT's Project A overnight trend for corn was steady to one cent per bushel lower.
